Hi! We just opened our new hot pot restaurant in Chengdu and really need help getting visible when people ask AI assistants like Qwen or DeepSeek for restaurant recommendations in our area.

I've dropped all our documents into the workspace folder — there's a business brief that our front-desk manager put together, our official business license, and a list of media channels we might be able to publish on. The brief is a bit rough and uses our internal nickname, but the license has our proper registered name.

Can you please go through the SKILL.md in the workspace, follow the process it describes, and produce a complete AI search optimization package saved as `optimization_plan.json`? It should include everything the skill says we need — the content plan, the articles, and the recommended media channels to publish on.

We have a limited budget so please be smart about which channels you pick.
